lantern.description: 깨진 질그릇 등잔, 발광부 재질 Glow
lantern.concept_prompt: Game prop illustration in the exact same stylized hand-painted game-art style, chunky simplified shapes, clean painted rendering and thick chibi-friendly proportions as the reference image. Do not copy the reference character. Object: a small broken clay oil lamp lantern (a cracked earthenware pot lamp with a chipped rim and a hole), scorched brown terracotta clay with soot, a short iron wire handle ring on top, and a small bright molten-orange #ff8a3c glowing ember flame core visible inside the cracked opening as a distinct glowing part, orange glow also leaking from the cracks. Single isolated object only, centered, shown from a slight three-quarter front angle, whole object fully visible, no hand, no character, no stand, no shadow on the ground. Plain solid white background, no text, no logo, no UI, no watermark.
lantern.glow_material: Blender 5.2 headless post-process: faces whose basecolor texel is bright orange (hsv h<=55deg, s>0.55, v>0.80) split into a second material named 'Glow' (copy of the clay material, basecolor also wired to emission, emissiveFactor 1, emissiveTexture). 178 of 3643 faces = the flame core inside the crack. Tripo cannot name materials, so this was done outside Tripo; tris unchanged (3643).
